item.title: Making Lin Yue Move
item.description: After building Lin Yue, the next challenge was making her move. A look at Kimodo motion references, a motor-inspired rig, procedural pose scripts, and the shoes and guards that had to move with her.

item.title: From Voxels to Lin Yue
item.description: What began as an experiment in reverse engineering a GLB became a journey through voxel scanning, mesh wrapping, procedural geometry and signed distance fields. Follow my attempts to build Lin Yue for The Jade Crypt, from mannequin-derived scans and awkward early prototypes to an original rigged character with procedural animations—and plenty of challenges still to solve.
